components.purpose: Benefit 1 of 3: a paragraph beside a picture, with the image on the right (ImagePosition = right).
Benefit 2 of 3: a paragraph beside a picture, with the image on the left (ImagePosition = left), alternating from benefit 1.
Benefit 3 of 3: a paragraph beside a picture, with the image on the right (ImagePosition = right), alternating from benefit 2.
